verified_claims.claim: 121 倍紫杉醇、364 倍巴卡丁 III 增产；98 μg/g FW paclitaxel，877 μg/g FW baccatin III。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.1 (abstract & introduction); p.6 主结果段; p.7 Discussion
verified_claims.evidence: p.1: 'resulting in a 121-fold increase in paclitaxel and a 364-fold increase in its valuable precursor baccatin III' 与 'reaching 98 μg/g fresh weight (FW), about 121 times greater compared to control cells, and the key intermediate baccatin III, reaching 877 μg/g FW, about 364 times the level seen in the control'

verified_claims.claim: MeJA 处理后 867 上调、749 下调基因；79 TFs 跨越 19 家族；19 候选 TF (6 AP2、4 MYB、5 NAC、2 bHLH、2 WRKY)。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.2 (GO/DEG 段) 及 p.3; Fig.1A
verified_claims.evidence: p.2: 'Transcriptomic profiling identified 867 up-regulated and 749 down-regulated genes following elicitation with MeJA'; p.3: 'From the 1646 DEGs, we identified 79 TFs spanning 19 different gene families…This selection yielded 19 candidate TFs, comprising six AP2, four MYB, five NAC, two bHLH, and two WRKY proteins'

verified_claims.claim: TcMYB3 在拟南芥 TEA 中无法激活 BAPT 与 T5αH，但在 Taxus CMC 原生质体 TEA 中可激活全部 10 个启动子；TcMYB4 互补 BAPT/T5αH。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.3–4 及 Fig.2A、Fig.3A 文字
verified_claims.evidence: p.3: 'TcMYB3 remarkably activated all tested promoters except for T5αH and BAPT'; 'TcMYB4 demonstrated the ability to up-regulate BAPT'; p.4: 'TcMYB3 failed to activate the promoters of BAPT and T5αH in the heterologous Arabidopsis TEA assay…Unexpectedly, TcMYB4 also significantly enhanced the activity of all these promoters'

verified_claims.claim: TcMYB3/4 共表达稳定系使紫杉醇与 MeJA 单独诱导效果相当 (98 vs 102 μg/g FW)。
verified_claims.evidence: p.7: 'Stable transgenic Taxus CMCs expressing this module exhibited significantly enhanced paclitaxel production (FW, 98 μg/g) (Fig. 4D) to a level equivalent to MeJA elicitation (FW, 102 μg/g) (20)'

verified_claims.claim: Phyton Biotech 工业产量约 1–2 g/kg；本课题组前期在 20 L 气升式生物反应器中 45 天诱导达 268 mg/kg。
verified_claims.evidence: p.7: 'While contemporary industrial company, Phyton Biotech, achieve yields of about 1 to 2 g/kg…Our previous work established that Taxus CMCs exhibit exceptional metabolic robustness during scale-up, with paclitaxel titers increasing from 102 mg/kg in shake flasks to 268 mg/kg in 20 liters of airlift bioreactors upon elicitation for 45 days'

verified_claims.claim: Ac 元件共有序列 A(A/C)C 是 TcMYB3/4 结合位点核心；TcMYB3 自启动子 BS-3 位于 −482 (序列 AACACC)。

verified_claims.claim: 蛋白标签: TcMYB3-HA (β-雌二醇诱导)、TcMYB4-MYC (Dex 诱导); 抗体 anti-HA、anti-MYC；β-Actin 内参。
